title: RAG Security and Privacy: Formalizing the Threat Model and Attack Surface
authors: Atousa Arzanipour; Rouzbeh Behnia; Reza Ebrahimi; Kaushik Dutta
why_relevant: Proposes a formal threat model and taxonomy for RAG security/privacy attacks including poisoning and membership inference, relevant to the adversarial corruption section.
